crossRefs.note: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”
I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing…
Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after…
For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can…
There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death.…
Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are…

translations.web: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”
translations.bsb: “Futility of futilities,” says the Teacher. “Everything is futile!”
translations.kjv: Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.
translations.asv: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher; all is vanity.
